entries.root_cause: The historical owner cone lacked both the OooStopPendingSequencer head0_csr_inflight state hold and the OooFrontendRunGate head0_csr_inflight owner-to-busy term. entries.root_cause: At C0 full-flush barrier, exact V9P RTL let OooIntBackend accept SQ-query replay into the bank-local retry holder and pop the MIQ while OooMemAxiBridge retained the same S_SQ_QUERY owner. The immutable run did not record which symmetric bank or tuple fired.
